text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High token accounting delta for tenant=Cobalt (VPC Dedicated pool). Billing spike detected — 4x expected tokens over last 30m. Auto-rate-limit triggered. Incident ID: INC-20260315-0423 :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: ack, paging in. Oncall here — looking now. Which pool is this hitting?

sre-maya: i see it on dedicated-pool-cobalt-01. Metrics: tokens/s jumped from ~1200 -> ~5200 at 04:06 UTC. Request size distribution unchanged. Tokenization latency spiked ~1.2s.

eng-anna: fyi we rolled tokenizer v2.4.1 to dedicated pools last night for improved unicode handling. Could be an encoding change.

oncall-ryan: can we throttle the tenant to prevent billing shock?

sre-maya: applying per-tenant token cap now: `redwoodctl tenant update --id=cobalt --token-cap=2000/s`

incident-bot: ACTION: Token cap applied for tenant=Cobalt on pool dedicated-pool-cobalt-01. Rate-limited new sessions.

cust-rep-tom: contacted Cobalt support channel. They are seeing inflated invoice previews. Asking for immediate credit hold.

account-julia: I'm looped in — will request finance hold for billing adjustments once we stabilize. Please capture sample requests.

eng-anna: running a quick diff between tokenizer v2.3.8 (last known good) and v2.4.1 on sample payloads. Strange: with certain mixed-encoding inputs (windows-1252 bytes surfacing as UTF-8), v2.4.1 yields +3x tokenized length. Repro locally.

sre-maya: can you post the minimal repro? we need to confirm impact surface (other tenants?)

eng-anna: paste below (redacted customer string):

```
# payload snippet
input: "Caf\u00e9 \u2019 menu\n – price €5"
# tokens v2.3.8: 8 tokens
# tokens v2.4.1: 24 tokens
```

eng-anna: looks like the stray 0x92 byte (windows-1252 left single quote) is being treated as separate replacement tokens by v2.4.1 when we force UTF-8 normalization.

oncall-ryan: is this limited to Cobalt's ingested content or can any tenant with mixed encodings hit it?

sre-maya: preliminary telemetry shows a handful of other VPC tenants with occasional spikes but nowhere near Cobalt's volume. Cobalt's ingestion pipeline is sending more legacy-encoded text.

oncall-ryan: mitigation plan: 1) rollback tokenizer to v2.3.8 on dedicated-pool-cobalt-01 2) keep per-tenant token cap 3) enable a normalization filter to drop/replace single-byte sequences until fix. 4) coordinate billing hold.

eng-anna: preparing rollback. Rolling back tokens service on nodes [gpux-7..9]. Command: `deployctl rollback service/tokenizer --pool dedicated-pool-cobalt-01 --to=v2.3.8`

incident-bot: NOTICE: Rollback job started (job-id rback-1861234578). Estimated 2m.

sre-maya: checking logs during rollback. No errors. Traffic gradually shifting to fallback instances. Token rate back to ~1100 tokens/s after ~90s.

cust-rep-tom: customer confirms their ingestion rate now aligns with expected billing preview. They asked for a postmortem and credit for the delta window.

account-julia: noted. I'll open a billing case and flag for expedited review. Capture exact incident window: 04:06 — 04:12 UTC.

eng-anna: root cause: tokenizer v2.4.1 UTF-8 normalization introduced an aggressive byte-preservation path where invalid single-byte codes were emitted as separate codepoints instead of mapped to replacement char. Fix is to add a pre-normalization step to coerce windows-1252 sequences -> proper unicode map. Patch PR opened: PR#1187.

oncall-ryan: handoff: I'm leaving the incident in monitoring. SRE Maya will take postmortem. Any outstanding items?

sre-maya: will collect logs, sample requests, and quantize cost delta. Also will verify Dedicated pool rollout gating in our deploy pipeline to prevent auto-promote without encoding regression tests.

eng-anna: will backport the normalization fix to v2.4.x and run compatibility tests across common legacy encodings.

cust-rep-tom: customer requests timeline and mitigation summary — I'll draft and share.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Tokenization anomaly mitigated, rollback complete, token rates normalized. Incident closed by oncall-ryan at 04:14 UTC.

sre-maya: postmortem owner assigned: @sre-maya. ETA for draft: EOD.

account-julia: finance hold placed for Cobalt for the delta window. Will follow up with refund/credit proposal after SRE cost calc. :+1:

oncall-ryan: thanks team. Leaving notes and logs in ops runbook: /opt/ops/incidents/INC-20260315-0423. Please tag me on the postmortem draft for review.
